summary_1line: The sage Narada arrives at Yudhishthira’s court and delivers an extensive interrogation on ideal kingship, governance, ethics, and statecraft.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant sage Narada enters Yudhishthira’s grand Sabha as the Pandavas rise and bow while musicians and celestial beings fill the hall.
Narada, seated before Yudhishthira in the royal court, raises his hand while delivering a long discourse on the duties of a king.
Yudhishthira humbly offers a jeweled seat, cows, and ritual arghya to the glowing sage Narada amid gathered kings and rishis.
